title: Jeep Comanche Engines by Year (1986–1992)
description: Every factory engine in the Jeep Comanche pickup by year, 1986–1992: the AMC 2.5 four, the GM 2.8 V6, the Renault 2.1 turbodiesel and the 4.0 straight six.
intro: The Comanche was a compact pickup built on the Cherokee XJ from 1986 to 1992.
Pick a year to see every engine offered that model year, with its code, rated horsepower and the trims it came in. Each engine links to its full specs.

generations.name: MJ
intro: It shared the Cherokee's engines: the 2.5 four, a GM 2.8 V6 for 1986, a Renault 2.1 turbodiesel for 1986–1987, and the 4.0 six from 1987.
